sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows Curium US LLC and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. have been on allocation for technetium tc 99m pyrophosphate since 2023-12-27.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 34 months.
A Class II recall by Curium US, LLC for lack of assurance of sterility and improper crimps on vials started 2024-11-26, 335 days after FDA posted the shortage.
The product label names Curium US LLC plants in Maryland Heights as the manufacturer.
The best option by rule is to buy from Cardinal Health 414, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

rejected.text: There is no public FDA signal at our plants for this drug.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-af34d1.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%technetium%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%technetium%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-8812b9.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('304b63f4-a32e-4700-805d-5bc9f27e7d6a') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-caa277.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%technetium%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-e2313d.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%technetium%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-f46d84.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%technetium%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-d2e5ad.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002807691', '3002806423', '3002724726', '1216602', '3009395771') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-d8ece7.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002807691', '3002806423', '3002724726', '1216602', '3009395771') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-210709.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('curium 2703 wagner place maryland heights', 'curium maryland heights')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-c89620.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('curium 2703 wagner place maryland heights', 'curium maryland heights', 'curium') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%technetium%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-c4d910.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('69945009420')
